usage: Usually used as a noun for fine silver, especially in traditional, historical, or literary contexts.
Can refer to silver by purity or quality; in everyday speech, the more common word is 銀.
Often appears in set phrases or formal descriptions, such as money, ornaments, or materials linked to value.
For learners: this word sounds a bit more formal than plain 銀, so you will hear it less in casual conversation.
